name: Quibi
one_line_pitch: Premium short-form mobile video episodes built for commuters.
primary_failure_reason: Misread consumer behavior and launched into a market that did not need another paid video subscription.
key_lessons: Validate habit frequency before content spend
Do not confuse celebrity supply with demand
Timing can erase a use case

name: Juicero
one_line_pitch: A connected countertop press for proprietary juice packs.
primary_failure_reason: Hardware complexity and high price failed to create value beyond a simpler manual alternative.
key_lessons: Prove the machine does something customers cannot already do
Avoid proprietary consumables unless value is obvious

name: MoviePass
one_line_pitch: A subscription that let members watch many theater movies for one monthly fee.
primary_failure_reason: The core offer was loved by users but structurally unprofitable at scale.
key_lessons: Great demand can still be fatal with negative unit economics
Model partner leverage before subsidizing usage
Watch for usage patterns that worsen with engagement

name: Theranos
one_line_pitch: Blood testing from tiny samples through proprietary machines.
primary_failure_reason: Technical claims outran validated science in a high-trust regulated market.
key_lessons: Healthcare trust must be earned with evidence
Regulatory reality is part of the product

name: Webvan
one_line_pitch: Online grocery ordering with rapid home delivery.
primary_failure_reason: Expanded capital-intensive logistics before demand density and fulfillment economics worked.
key_lessons: Scale does not fix weak contribution margin

name: Pets.com
one_line_pitch: Online pet supplies delivered to homes.
primary_failure_reason: Spent aggressively on brand before margins, logistics, and repeat economics were ready.
key_lessons: Brand cannot rescue poor gross margin
Measure repeat behavior before mass marketing

name: Color Labs
one_line_pitch: A proximity-based mobile photo sharing network.
primary_failure_reason: Raised and built ahead of a clear user behavior or compelling social graph.
key_lessons: Social apps need an atomic habit
Funding does not create network effects
Explain the use case in one breath

name: Beepi
one_line_pitch: A managed marketplace for buying and selling used cars online.
primary_failure_reason: Heavy operations and cash burn overwhelmed marketplace liquidity gains.
key_lessons: Managed marketplaces need tight operational scope
Inventory risk changes the business model
Trust features must pay for themselves

name: Jawbone
one_line_pitch: Consumer fitness trackers and connected audio devices.
primary_failure_reason: Product quality issues and brutal hardware competition eroded the brand.
key_lessons: Competing with platform owners is hard

name: Better Place
one_line_pitch: Battery swapping infrastructure for electric vehicles.
primary_failure_reason: Required massive ecosystem coordination before enough compatible cars and demand existed.

name: Homejoy
one_line_pitch: On-demand home cleaning booked online.
primary_failure_reason: Low retention, worker classification pressure, and thin margins made growth fragile.

name: Fab.com
one_line_pitch: Flash sales and discovery for design-forward products.
primary_failure_reason: Rapid pivots and expansion created operational drag without durable differentiation.
key_lessons: Flash sale demand can be shallow
Pivots do not erase execution debt

name: Aereo
one_line_pitch: Cloud-based broadcast television streaming through tiny antennas.
primary_failure_reason: The business depended on a legal interpretation that courts rejected.

name: Bodega
one_line_pitch: Smart pantry boxes as an alternative to corner stores.
primary_failure_reason: Brand positioning triggered backlash and the model lacked clear advantage over existing retail.

name: Clinkle
one_line_pitch: A secretive mobile payments app for students.
primary_failure_reason: Hype and funding preceded a compelling product in a crowded payments market.
key_lessons: Campus adoption must translate into retention

name: Rdio
one_line_pitch: A polished subscription music streaming service.
primary_failure_reason: Strong product was outdistributed by larger competitors with better bundles and marketing.
key_lessons: Product quality alone may not beat distribution

name: Vine
one_line_pitch: A short looping video social network.
primary_failure_reason: Creator monetization and product direction lagged while competitors copied and extended the format.
key_lessons: Creators need economic reasons to stay

name: Secret
one_line_pitch: Anonymous sharing with friends and nearby users.
primary_failure_reason: Engagement leaned toward harmful behavior and trust problems rather than durable connection.
key_lessons: Trust and safety is core infrastructure

name: Yik Yak
one_line_pitch: Anonymous location-based message boards for campuses.
primary_failure_reason: Moderation challenges and fading novelty undermined campus network effects.

name: Google Glass Explorer
one_line_pitch: Consumer smart glasses with camera and glanceable computing.
primary_failure_reason: Privacy concerns, unclear use cases, and awkward social acceptance blocked mainstream adoption.
key_lessons: Social acceptability is a product requirement
Developer ecosystems need clear use cases

name: Essential Products
one_line_pitch: Premium Android phones and ambient computing devices.
primary_failure_reason: Entered a mature smartphone market without enough differentiation or distribution.
key_lessons: Mature hardware categories punish late entrants

name: Solyndra
one_line_pitch: Cylindrical solar panels for commercial rooftops.
primary_failure_reason: Manufacturing economics collapsed as conventional solar prices fell faster than expected.
key_lessons: Cost curves can invalidate technical differentiation

name: Munchery
one_line_pitch: Prepared meal delivery from central kitchens.
primary_failure_reason: Food waste, logistics, and demand forecasting made the model expensive to operate.

name: Sprig
one_line_pitch: On-demand healthy meals delivered quickly.
primary_failure_reason: Vertically integrated food operations could not support sustainable delivery economics.
key_lessons: Owning the full stack raises burn
Menu simplicity helps but does not fix logistics

name: Daqri
one_line_pitch: Industrial augmented reality headsets and software.
primary_failure_reason: Enterprise AR hardware arrived before cost, comfort, and workflows were ready.

name: Nasty Gal
one_line_pitch: Online fashion retail built from a distinctive brand voice.
primary_failure_reason: Growth outpaced operational maturity and inventory discipline.
key_lessons: Brand heat must convert into repeatable operations
Culture and systems must scale together

name: Washio
one_line_pitch: On-demand laundry and dry cleaning pickup.
primary_failure_reason: Convenience was attractive but route logistics and labor costs weakened margins.
key_lessons: Local ops do not scale like software

name: Shyp
one_line_pitch: On-demand pickup, packing, and shipping for consumers and businesses.
primary_failure_reason: A labor-intensive consumer convenience model lacked enough frequency and margin.
key_lessons: B2B focus may need to come earlier

name: Tink Labs
one_line_pitch: Free hotel smartphones for travelers with local services and ads.
primary_failure_reason: Hardware deployment costs and weak monetization collided as traveler behavior shifted.
key_lessons: Smartphone ubiquity can erase the need

name: Powa Technologies
one_line_pitch: Mobile payments and commerce tools for merchants.
primary_failure_reason: Overstated partnerships and broad ambition hid weak adoption.
key_lessons: Credibility collapses when traction is inflated

name: FTX
one_line_pitch: A global cryptocurrency exchange and derivatives trading platform.
primary_failure_reason: Misappropriated billions in customer funds to support sister hedge fund Alameda Research, with founder Sam Bankman-Fried convicted of fraud after the platform collapsed.

name: Terra/Luna
one_line_pitch: Algorithmic stablecoin ecosystem promising stable value through token mechanics.
primary_failure_reason: The algorithmic peg between UST and LUNA collapsed in a death spiral, wiping out approximately $40 billion in value within days.
key_lessons: Algorithmic stablecoins face reflexive failure modes
Yield products that seem too good usually are
Mechanism design must account for panic scenarios

name: Three Arrows Capital
one_line_pitch: A cryptocurrency hedge fund managing billions in digital assets.
primary_failure_reason: Excessive leverage and concentrated bets on Terra/Luna and other crypto positions led to insolvency when markets crashed.
key_lessons: Concentration disguised as conviction is dangerous

name: Celsius Network
one_line_pitch: A crypto lending platform offering high yields on deposits.
primary_failure_reason: Risky DeFi investments and a liquidity crunch led to bankruptcy after the platform froze customer withdrawals.
key_lessons: Yield promises require sustainable revenue sources
Customer trust is destroyed by withdrawal freezes

name: Voyager Digital
one_line_pitch: A cryptocurrency broker offering commission-free trading and yield products.
primary_failure_reason: Massive exposure to Three Arrows Capital triggered insolvency when 3AC defaulted on loans.
key_lessons: Lending to hedge funds is not a stable business
Risk management must include single-customer limits

name: BlockFi
one_line_pitch: A crypto financial services platform offering interest accounts and loans.
primary_failure_reason: Significant exposure to FTX and Alameda triggered bankruptcy after FTX's collapse.

name: Genesis Global Capital
one_line_pitch: Institutional crypto lending and trading services provider.
primary_failure_reason: Cascading failures from Three Arrows Capital and FTX exposures led to bankruptcy.
key_lessons: Wholesale funding markets transmit shocks rapidly
Diligence on borrowers requires operational depth

name: Convoy
one_line_pitch: A digital freight network connecting truckers with shippers.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down despite raising $1.1 billion as freight market downturn and weak unit economics overwhelmed the company.
key_lessons: Heavy fundraising can mask fragile unit economics

name: Olive AI
one_line_pitch: AI-powered automation platform for healthcare administrative tasks.
primary_failure_reason: Despite a $4 billion valuation and $850 million raised, the company struggled with overpromised AI capabilities and unsustainable growth, leading to shutdown.
key_lessons: AI claims must match delivered capabilities
Healthcare sales cycles need patient capital

name: Fast
one_line_pitch: One-click checkout technology for online retailers.
primary_failure_reason: Burned $10 million monthly while generating only $600K in 2021 revenue, with massive overspending on marketing and team before product-market fit.
key_lessons: Hiring ahead of revenue creates fragility

name: Bird
one_line_pitch: Electric scooter sharing service for urban transportation.
primary_failure_reason: Filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy after massive losses, vehicle theft and damage costs, regulatory battles, and inability to reach profitability despite billions in funding.
key_lessons: City regulations can constrain growth indefinitely

name: Vroom
one_line_pitch: An online platform for buying and selling used cars.
primary_failure_reason: Wound down e-commerce operations after years of losses, with declining used car prices and weak unit economics making the model unviable.
key_lessons: Used car logistics are operationally brutal
Online-only purchase models for big-ticket items face headwinds

name: WeWork
one_line_pitch: Flexible office space and coworking memberships globally.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for bankruptcy after years of mounting losses, failed IPO, and inability to reconcile long-term lease commitments with short-term member contracts during pandemic disruption.
key_lessons: Maturity mismatches in real estate are dangerous
Tech valuations cannot reframe real estate businesses

name: Bolt Mobility
one_line_pitch: Electric scooter and bike sharing service in cities.
primary_failure_reason: Abruptly shut down operations across cities, abandoning vehicles in public spaces with no notice to customers or municipalities.
key_lessons: City partnerships require trust and process

name: Veev
one_line_pitch: Modular home construction with technology-driven prefabrication.
primary_failure_reason: Despite $600 million raised, ran out of capital before achieving production scale, hampered by housing market downturn and capital intensity.
key_lessons: Modular promises take longer than projected

name: Volocopter
one_line_pitch: Electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft for urban air mobility.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for insolvency after failing to secure additional funding for certification and commercial launch despite years of development.
key_lessons: Hardware certification takes longer than expected
Regulated aviation needs deep capital reserves

name: Embark Trucks
one_line_pitch: Self-driving truck technology for highway freight.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down operations and laid off most staff after going public via SPAC, citing commercialization timelines stretching beyond available capital.
key_lessons: Cash runway must match technical milestones

name: Argo AI
one_line_pitch: Self-driving vehicle technology platform with Ford and Volkswagen backing.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after Ford and Volkswagen withdrew funding, recognizing autonomous vehicle commercialization was further away than projected.

name: Virgin Hyperloop
one_line_pitch: High-speed hyperloop transportation system using vacuum tubes.
primary_failure_reason: Pivoted from passenger to cargo and laid off most staff before effectively winding down, with technology and economics never demonstrating commercial viability.
key_lessons: Public funding hopes do not equal projects
Pivots away from original vision signal trouble

name: Zume Pizza
one_line_pitch: Robotic pizza making and delivery using mobile cooking trucks.
primary_failure_reason: Pivoted multiple times before shutting down, with robotic pizza assembly never achieving cost or quality advantages over traditional methods.
key_lessons: Robotics in food service rarely beats labor
Multiple pivots without traction signal model issues
SoftBank backing did not validate the model

name: Bowery Farming
one_line_pitch: Indoor vertical farms growing leafy greens with AI and automation.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for bankruptcy after years of losses, as energy costs, capital intensity, and weak retail margins overwhelmed the model.
key_lessons: Vertical farming economics rarely work for cheap crops
Specialty produce margins cannot offset capex

name: Wirecard
one_line_pitch: Global payment processing and financial technology services.
primary_failure_reason: Collapsed after revealing $2 billion in cash on its balance sheet did not exist, exposing one of Europe's largest accounting frauds.
key_lessons: Rapid international expansion can hide fraud
Short sellers often see what regulators miss

name: Greensill Capital
one_line_pitch: Supply chain financing and working capital solutions for businesses.
primary_failure_reason: Collapsed after losing credit insurance for risky exposures, revealing concentrated lending to a single client and weak underwriting.
key_lessons: Insurance dependency creates single points of failure
Concentrated borrower risk hides in growth

name: Plastiq
one_line_pitch: Allowed businesses to pay vendors with credit cards even when not accepted.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for bankruptcy after a planned SPAC deal fell through and rising interest rates made the credit-card-funded payment model unsustainable.
key_lessons: Interest rate sensitivity must be modeled
SPAC dependency was a strategic vulnerability
Card economics shifts can break business models

name: Kabbage
one_line_pitch: Online platform providing automated small business loans.
primary_failure_reason: Lending operations collapsed during pandemic credit crisis, leading to fire sale acquisition by American Express after the lending arm shut down.
key_lessons: Tech-forward underwriting still depends on capital markets

name: Outcome Health
one_line_pitch: Health information displays in doctors' offices funded by pharmaceutical advertising.
primary_failure_reason: Collapsed after fraud revelations showed executives had falsified data to advertisers about ad reach and effectiveness, leading to criminal convictions.
key_lessons: Advertising metrics fraud is criminal exposure

name: Forward Health
one_line_pitch: AI-enabled primary care clinics with subscription pricing.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down all clinics abruptly despite raising $650 million, after struggling to scale tech-enabled clinical model and pivoting to autonomous care pods.
key_lessons: Healthcare delivery is harder than software
Pivots in capital-intensive models compound problems

name: Babylon Health
one_line_pitch: AI-powered telehealth and primary care services.
primary_failure_reason: Went bankrupt after going public via SPAC, with mounting losses, AI capability questions, and unsustainable business model in US market.
key_lessons: Healthcare AI claims need clinical validation

name: Brandless
one_line_pitch: Direct-to-consumer brand selling everything for $3.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after failing to find sustainable customer acquisition economics with low average order values, despite SoftBank backing.
key_lessons: Low AOV makes paid acquisition impossible
SoftBank capital cannot fix unit economics

name: Birchbox
one_line_pitch: Monthly beauty product subscription boxes.
primary_failure_reason: Sold for parts after years of decline, as subscription fatigue, churn, and free shipping costs overwhelmed the model.
key_lessons: Curation business is hard to defend
Beauty discovery moved to other channels

name: Lordstown Motors
one_line_pitch: Electric pickup trucks targeted at commercial fleets.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after years of production delays, allegations of inflated pre-orders, and inability to scale manufacturing.
key_lessons: Manufacturing pickup trucks is harder than slides suggest

name: Lilium
one_line_pitch: Electric jet for regional air mobility.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for insolvency after failing to secure additional funding, with technical challenges and certification timelines outstripping capital.
key_lessons: eVTOL development is more expensive than projected
Government funding hopes are not strategy

name: Reef Technology
one_line_pitch: Network of ghost kitchens and parking lot logistics hubs.
primary_failure_reason: Massive layoffs and effective wind-down after parking lot ghost kitchen model proved operationally complex and unprofitable despite SoftBank funding.
key_lessons: Real estate-tech hybrids inherit both problems
SoftBank scale strategy did not work

name: Maple
one_line_pitch: Vertically integrated meal delivery with proprietary kitchens.
primary_failure_reason: Despite high-quality food and David Chang involvement, unit economics never worked due to delivery costs and labor.
key_lessons: Quality food delivery rarely has margin
Celebrity backing does not fix economics

name: Sonder
one_line_pitch: Tech-enabled apartment-style accommodations for travelers.
primary_failure_reason: Years of losses, going-concern warnings, and operational challenges after pandemic, ultimately rescued by Marriott licensing deal but original model failed.
key_lessons: Asset-light hospitality still has lease commitments
Tech wrappers do not transform real estate

name: Selina
one_line_pitch: Hostels and co-living spaces for digital nomads.
primary_failure_reason: Filed for restructuring after going public via SPAC, with debt loads and post-pandemic occupancy challenges overwhelming the model.
key_lessons: Lifestyle real estate has cyclical demand
SPACs took companies public too early
Niche traveler segments cannot support broad expansion

name: Byju's
one_line_pitch: Online learning and tutoring platform for K-12 students globally.
primary_failure_reason: Once valued at $22 billion, faced insolvency proceedings amid accusations of aggressive sales tactics, financial irregularities, and post-pandemic learning slowdown.
key_lessons: Aggressive sales tactics create regulatory risk

name: BloomTech
one_line_pitch: Online coding bootcamp with income share agreements.
primary_failure_reason: Effectively shut down after California regulators ordered cease and desist over loan disclosure violations, alongside placement rate concerns.
key_lessons: Tech labor market shifts hit bootcamps hard

name: Pebble
one_line_pitch: Smartwatch with e-paper display and cross-platform support.
primary_failure_reason: Sold to Fitbit for parts after Apple Watch and Google entered the smartwatch market, eroding Pebble's pioneer advantage.
key_lessons: Crowdfunding success does not equal market readiness

name: Anki
one_line_pitch: Consumer robotics company making toy robots and Cozmo.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after failing to close additional funding, despite technically impressive products that could not generate sustainable consumer revenue.
key_lessons: Hardware dev cycles outpace consumer interest

name: Jibo
one_line_pitch: Family social robot with AI and emotional intelligence.
primary_failure_reason: Shipped late after Amazon Echo and Google Home dominated voice-AI market, leaving Jibo's premium price unjustifiable.
key_lessons: Hardware delays cede markets to platforms
Premium consumer hardware needs clear differentiation

name: Coolest Cooler
one_line_pitch: Multi-function cooler with blender, speaker, and battery.
primary_failure_reason: Despite raising over $13 million on Kickstarter, manufacturing costs and complexity led to insolvency before fulfilling all backer orders.
key_lessons: Feature creep is a hardware killer
Backer expectations are different from customers

name: Skully Helmets
one_line_pitch: AR-enabled motorcycle helmets with HUD and rear camera.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after misuse of crowdfunding funds and inability to deliver promised product to backers.
key_lessons: Crowdfunded hardware needs strict financial discipline
Founder spending on luxury items destroys trust
Complex AR hardware faces unit-cost reality

name: OnLive
one_line_pitch: Cloud-based gaming service streaming games to any device.
primary_failure_reason: Burned through capital before broadband infrastructure and consumer adoption caught up with the cloud gaming vision.
key_lessons: Cloud gaming was right idea wrong decade
Pioneers often fund the market for successors

name: OUYA
one_line_pitch: Open Android-based home gaming console.
primary_failure_reason: Failed to attract quality games or sustained users, with hardware sales collapsing within a year of launch.
key_lessons: Open platforms struggle to attract publishers
Kickstarter validation is not market validation

name: Magic Leap
one_line_pitch: Spatial computing augmented reality glasses for consumers.
primary_failure_reason: Burned billions before pivoting to enterprise after consumer headset failed to find market, with technology not matching the marketing.
key_lessons: AR hardware has not matched promises

name: Mic.com
one_line_pitch: News and culture content for millennials.
primary_failure_reason: Sold for fire sale price after pivot to video failed and Facebook algorithm changes destroyed traffic.
key_lessons: Pivot to video was a Facebook trap

name: MapR
one_line_pitch: Enterprise data platform built on Hadoop.
primary_failure_reason: Hadoop market collapsed as cloud-native data platforms emerged, with HPE acquiring assets at fire sale prices.
key_lessons: Enterprise software has long but finite cycles

name: Pixelon
one_line_pitch: Internet video streaming technology.
primary_failure_reason: Founder turned out to be a fugitive con man and the technology did not work as claimed, after spending most funding on a Las Vegas launch party.
key_lessons: Marketing should not exceed product capabilities

name: Boo.com
one_line_pitch: Online fashion retailer with global ambitions.
primary_failure_reason: Burned $135 million in 18 months on lavish marketing and complex Flash-based site that loaded slowly on dial-up connections.

name: Kozmo.com
one_line_pitch: One-hour delivery of small consumer goods.
primary_failure_reason: Free delivery on small-ticket items destroyed unit economics, with messengers losing money on most orders.
key_lessons: Free delivery on small orders is unsustainable
Unit economics must work without scale

name: Flooz.com
one_line_pitch: Online currency for gift-giving and shopping.
primary_failure_reason: Failed to gain merchant or consumer adoption, with the proprietary currency model never solving a real problem better than dollars.
key_lessons: Merchant adoption is hard to bootstrap

name: Beenz.com
one_line_pitch: Internet currency earned through online activities.
primary_failure_reason: Could not establish meaningful merchant network or consumer adoption for proprietary points currency.
key_lessons: Loyalty currencies are hard to bootstrap

name: eToys
one_line_pitch: Online toy retailer with seasonal demand spikes.
primary_failure_reason: Holiday season fulfillment failures and inability to compete with Toys R Us and Amazon partnerships drove bankruptcy.

name: Govworks.com
one_line_pitch: Online platform for paying government fees and accessing services.
primary_failure_reason: Featured in documentary 'Startup.com', failed due to slow government partnerships, weak revenue model, and team conflict.
key_lessons: Government sales cycles are very long
Public sector innovation needs patient capital

name: Digital Convergence
one_line_pitch: CueCat barcode scanner connecting print ads to websites.
primary_failure_reason: Free hardware giveaway failed when consumers had no compelling reason to scan magazine codes to visit websites.
key_lessons: Adding friction to information rarely helps

name: Ofo
one_line_pitch: Dockless bike sharing across China and globally.
primary_failure_reason: Cash crisis after global expansion outpaced unit economics, with massive bike inventory damage and theft compounding losses.
key_lessons: Global expansion before local profitability is risky

name: oBike
one_line_pitch: Dockless bike sharing in Singapore and globally.
primary_failure_reason: Abruptly ceased operations after city regulations and abandoned bikes created backlash, leaving deposit refund issues.

name: A123 Systems
one_line_pitch: Advanced lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and grid storage.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after Fisker Automotive faltered and Chinese competitors undercut prices, with manufacturing scale challenges.

name: Aquion Energy
one_line_pitch: Saltwater batteries for grid energy storage.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after lithium-ion prices fell faster than expected, eliminating saltwater battery cost advantage.
key_lessons: Cost curves can erase technical advantages
Energy storage is a commodity market

name: Fisker Automotive
one_line_pitch: Premium plug-in hybrid electric vehicles.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after battery supplier A123 collapsed, manufacturing problems mounted, and capital ran out.

name: Theranos competitors
one_line_pitch: uBiome, microbiome diagnostic and consumer testing kits.
primary_failure_reason: uBiome shut down after FBI investigation into insurance billing practices and questions about clinical validity.

name: Improbable Worlds
one_line_pitch: Cloud-based simulation technology for massive multiplayer games.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down most operations after years of pivots, failing to find product-market fit despite SoftBank-led $500 million funding.
key_lessons: SoftBank funding does not validate models

name: Pearl Automation
one_line_pitch: Aftermarket backup cameras and driver aids.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after retail demand for $500 backup cameras did not materialize, with auto OEMs including features as standard.

name: Shyp competitor Postmates
one_line_pitch: On-demand local delivery from any store or restaurant.
primary_failure_reason: Acquired by Uber for $2.65 billion after years of losses and failure to compete with DoorDash, effectively a fire sale of independent existence.
key_lessons: Two-sided marketplaces are hard to defend

name: Caviar
one_line_pitch: Premium restaurant delivery service.
primary_failure_reason: Sold to DoorDash by Square after struggling to differentiate from mass-market delivery competitors despite premium positioning.
key_lessons: Food delivery economics squeeze all comers

name: Lily Robotics
one_line_pitch: Self-flying camera drone that follows users automatically.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after taking $34 million in pre-orders without delivering products, with FTC charges over deceptive marketing.

name: Doppler Labs
one_line_pitch: Smart earbuds with active sound control.
primary_failure_reason: Burned $50 million before AirPods and similar products dominated market, with Doppler's premium price unjustifiable.
key_lessons: Apple competition is brutal in earbuds

name: Knock
one_line_pitch: Buy-before-you-sell home transaction platform.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after housing market downturn made the bridge financing model untenable, with rising rates compounding issues.

name: Reali
one_line_pitch: Online real estate platform with cash offer programs.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down operations as rising interest rates and housing slowdown destroyed iBuyer-like programs and cash offer economics.
key_lessons: Inventory carry costs scale with rates
Real estate tech follows housing cycles

name: Better.com
one_line_pitch: Online mortgage platform with faster approvals.
primary_failure_reason: Massive layoffs and going public via SPAC at fraction of valuation after rate environment destroyed mortgage refi business and CEO controversy.
key_lessons: Tech wrappers do not eliminate cyclicality

name: Inflection AI
one_line_pitch: Personal AI assistant with empathetic conversation.
primary_failure_reason: Effectively dissolved when Microsoft hired most staff and licensed technology, after failing to find sustainable consumer AI revenue model.
key_lessons: Consumer AI has unclear willingness to pay
Talent acquisition can substitute for company outcome
Big tech licensing is a soft landing

name: Adept AI
one_line_pitch: AI agents that perform tasks across software applications.
primary_failure_reason: Acqui-hired by Amazon after struggling to ship products despite founding team pedigree and substantial funding.
key_lessons: AI agent products are harder than research

name: Character AI
one_line_pitch: AI character chatbots for entertainment and roleplay.
primary_failure_reason: Founders returned to Google in licensing deal after consumer engagement failed to translate to revenue, with safety concerns mounting.
key_lessons: AI companion safety needs serious investment
Consumer engagement does not equal revenue

name: Humane AI
one_line_pitch: AI-powered wearable Pin to replace smartphones.
primary_failure_reason: Sold assets to HP for fraction of valuation after Pin launched to scathing reviews, returns exceeded sales, and product overheated.
key_lessons: AI demos do not equal AI products

name: Nikola Motor
one_line_pitch: Electric and hydrogen-fueled commercial trucks.
primary_failure_reason: Filed bankruptcy after years of struggles following founder fraud conviction and inability to scale production despite SPAC capital.
key_lessons: Truck manufacturing requires deep operational expertise

name: Pearl
one_line_pitch: AI-powered dental diagnostics for veterinary clinics.
primary_failure_reason: Pearl Health pivoted from earlier model after pet diagnostics startup struggled to gain veterinary adoption and reimbursement.
key_lessons: Veterinary markets have unique adoption barriers

name: Gilt Groupe
one_line_pitch: Members-only flash sales for designer fashion.
primary_failure_reason: Sold for fraction of peak valuation as flash-sale demand declined and brand discovery shifted to Instagram and other channels.

name: ZenPayroll
one_line_pitch: Originally ZenPayroll, predecessor naming for what became Gusto, considered failed in original consumer HR concept.
primary_failure_reason: Pivoted away from original direct-to-consumer concept to small business B2B model, with original concept effectively failing.

name: Munchery competitor Spoonrocket
one_line_pitch: Cheap, fast meal delivery with limited menu.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after low price points combined with delivery costs created unsustainable economics.
key_lessons: Cheap delivery has structural margin issues

name: Sprig competitor Bento
one_line_pitch: Customizable Asian-inspired meal delivery.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down after meal delivery economics proved unsustainable for boutique players.
key_lessons: Boutique delivery cannot compete on cost

name: Triage
one_line_pitch: Healthcare staffing and shift management platform.
primary_failure_reason: Shut down as healthcare staffing margins compressed post-pandemic and competition intensified.

name: Mirror
one_line_pitch: Wall-mounted smart mirror for at-home fitness classes.
primary_failure_reason: Lululemon shut down the product after acquiring it for $500 million, with hardware sales collapsing post-pandemic.
key_lessons: Strategic acquisitions can fail to integrate
